summary: Updated manual test summary/detail display and empty-array handling across goal completion flows. all_done events now preserve manualTests when defined (including []), persistManualTests now stores [] as a valid no-tests state, gTD details now render human-readable headers with inline description and optional reason plus step-formatted detail text, and compact completion summaries now distinguish undefined/null from [] and render Manual Tests with Test N: lines (including a No manual tests needed state). Added/updated tests in goal-commands and compact-output for new formatting and persistence semantics. Verified with pnpm vitest run src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts src/goal/compact-output.test.ts, pnpm lint, and pnpm build.
